kwargs.prompt: Pixar-style 3D animation, close-up. The girl's curious sideways glance turns into wide-eyed wonder as she looks up, then a big joyful gap-toothed smile spreads across her face and she laughs softly, her curly pigtails gently bouncing in the breeze. Balloons float softly in the blurred background. Slow push-in, warm golden backlight. Sound: light breeze, a happy child's soft laugh, gentle music.
kwargs.negative_prompt: captions, subtitles, text, watermark, bad quality, blurry face, deformed hands, extra fingers, distorted eyes, morphing, flicker
